name: Class of '09: The Flip Side
source:
The franchise is back with Jecka in control of the Class of '09 story! Nicole's blonde best friend comes with her own set of traumatic problems you'll need to navigate her through. There are 5 more endings with another secret bonus video for you to watch to discover the true meaning of this wild series.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2757330/]Steam[/url]]
